# Solo Speaker Studio

> Solo Speaker Studio is an AI-powered preparation workspace for people who write, rehearse and deliver talks regularly: public speakers, pastors, trainers, founders and content creators. It turns rough ideas into structured talks, rewrites text so it sounds natural out loud, estimates speaking duration, and provides a distraction-free teleprompter mode with real-time voice follow. Available in English and French at https://solospeaker.com.

Key facts:
- Product category: AI speech coach, teleprompter and speech-writing software (web application).
- Free trial: up to 5 talks, no time limit, no credit card required.
- Paid plans: Studio (individual), Pro and Team (billed monthly or yearly, prices in EUR).
- Core workflow: idea → structured outline with sections → AI-assisted writing and oral rewriting → rehearsal with timing → teleprompter delivery → PDF export.
- Differentiator vs. general tools (Google Docs, Notion): built specifically for spoken talks — sections with estimated durations, voice notes, rehearsal analytics and teleprompter mode in one flow.
